decisions.fork: Where does the MaturitySummaryCard UI belong — hand-rolled in the MFE, or consumed from the design system?
decisions.choice: Consume eq-one-design-system SummaryCard; do not hand-roll.
decisions.rationale: dna-precheck found an equivalent SummaryCard in eq-one-design-system; dedup-policy REUSE precedence forbids re-creating it in the child MFE.

decisions.fork: Should the balance/holdings store be declared in eq-one-saye-mfe or reused from eq-one-shared?
decisions.rationale: Lesson L-014: balance/holdings stores live in eq-one-shared and child MFEs import them; declaring a sibling copy would duplicate code across MFEs.

decisions.fork: Place the new feature in an existing MFE or stand up a new child MFE?
decisions.choice: EXTEND the existing eq-one-saye-mfe; no new MFE.
decisions.rationale: Saye maturity is squarely within the existing saye domain surface; standing up a new MFE would violate boundaries and inflate budget.
